title: Reference artifacts and source precedence
summary: Use exact accepted artifacts and immutable Git identities when reconstructing this design. Prefer executable package contracts over recollection; preserve the difference between source authority, interpretation, compiler certification and publication authority.
invariants: Legal Effect v0.14 is the primary executable source for legal-effect semantics and compiler/counterfactual boundaries.
Intention Service dev11 is the primary executable source for dynamic discovery and READY/dispatch semantics.
Institutional Policy v0.8 is the primary executable source for publication/effective lifecycle governance.
Legal Interrogation dev5 is the primary source for the upstream interrogatory authoring/lifecycle layer.
Historical anecdotes and external legal examples are test material only until their source/provenance is established.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 owns structured legal-effect evaluation and the compiler/certification authority boundary; public legal API remains legal.effect/0.10.
Intention Service dev11 owns CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY resolution, discovery-provider refresh/replacement semantics and discovery-generation stamping.
Institutional Policy owns fixed/versioned publication identity, authority, effective time, lifecycle, topology, rollout and replay rather than domain legal semantics.
Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
Git submission branch contains the immutable two-commit Legal Interrogation dev5 Autobuild envelope; receipt was pending at sphere authoring time.
